title: Roop Ki Rani Choron Ka Raja
desc: Jugran kills a customs officer and a doctor, leaving their kids orphaned. As they grow up facing hardships, the children unite to take revenge on their parents' killer.

title: Ujda Chaman
desc: Chaman Kohli, a 30-year-old bachelor with premature balding, faces a hilarious deadline from an astrologer to find a wife or stay single forever. Challenge accepted!

title: Khushi
desc: Khushi and Karan share a fiery love-hate bond, but while playing cupid for their friends, they unexpectedly grow close and end up falling in love with each other.

title: Welcome To New York
desc: A recovery agent and a designer get swept into a grand Bollywood event in New York, where unexpected chaos unfolds-altering their lives in ways they never imagined.

title: Cheeni Kum
desc: Buddhadev, a 64-year-old chef, falls for Nina, 34. Their future is shaken when he learns her father is six years younger than him, casting doubt on their relationship.

title: Rascals
desc: Two con artists, Chetan and Bhagat, fall in love with Khushi and try to win her over. However, Anthony, an old victim of their cons, kidnaps Khushi to get his money back from them.

title: Madaari
desc: After losing his son due to government negligence, Nirmal kidnaps the home minister's ten-year-old son. He demands justice and forces the administration to face his painful revenge.

title: Jayantabhai Ki Luv Story
desc: Simran, a young engineer new to Mumbai, moves into a tough area. Jayantabhai, a small gangster, helps her and falls in love, but her father disapproves.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Hello Darling
desc: Candy, Mansi, and Satvari work at a fashion store, but face constant harassment from their creepy manager Hardhik, making their daily lives stressful and full of uncomfortable challenges.

title: Gambler
desc: Inspector Dayashanker, though lazy, accidentally uncovers a big criminal plot and suddenly becomes a hero in his department. But angry gangsters make his life a nightmare.

title: Kyon Ho Gaya Na
desc: Diya and Arjun clash over love and marriage. But as they spend time together, their differences fade and love blossoms between them.

title: Pal Pal Dil Ke Paas
desc: Saher, a video blogger, travels alone to expose Karan, a tourism company owner she believes is a fraud. What begins with clash and mistrust slowly turns into love.

title: Army
desc: After army officer Arjun is brutally killed by gangster Naagraj, his wife Geeta vows revenge and forms a group of determined young men to bring Naagraj down.

title: Dabangg
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, fights corruption his own way. Cheddi Singh creates a rift with his step-brother, exploiting it for power, forcing Chulbul to battle enemies inside and outside.

title: Murder 2
desc: Arjun, a former cop, takes on the case of missing sex workers. To catch the culprit, young Reshma bravely steps in as bait-risking everything to expose the truth.

title: Traffic Signal
desc: Silsila, a street-smart young man who manages various trades at a Mumbai traffic signal, sees his life crumble when he unknowingly helps execute a murder.
